extension.summary: Apple Siri Remote support for Kodi
extension.description: Connects to an Apple Siri Remote via Bluetooth and maps button presses to Kodi actions. Supports navigation, play/pause, volume control, and more.
extension.news:
v1.3.0 (2025-10-24) - Major improvement: Service now tolerates sleeping/unavailable remotes - Remotes auto-connect when they wake up (no restart needed!) - 10-second polling when remote is asleep, 3-second retry for other errors - Smart logging: initial message when waiting, then periodic updates every 2 minutes - Clear status messages indicating when remotes connect/disconnect - Reduced startup delay to 2 seconds for faster service initialization
v1.2.1 (2025-10-23) - Fixed boot initialization issue - remotes now connect automatically after reboot - Added Bluetooth service readiness check with 30-second timeout - Added startup delay to allow system services to initialize - Improved error messages for device pairing/trust issues
v1.2.0 (2025-10-23) - Full multi-remote support - connect to up to 4 remotes simultaneously - All enabled remotes run concurrently with automatic reconnection - Per-remote logging and error handling - Independent connection management for each remote
v1.1.0 (2025-10-23) - Added support for multiple remote configuration (up to 4 remotes) - Each remote can be individually enabled/disabled - Added custom naming for each remote - Automatic migration from old single-remote settings
v1.0.0 (2025-10-17) - Initial release - Support for Apple Siri Remote button mapping - Configurable MAC address via settings - Enable/disable toggle
